summary: Jacobs Creek: FS page, FS map PDF, rec.gov facility/catalog/rates/availability, Esri and 3DEP read. Closed since Helene (no repair date; all 2027 nights closed) - status temporarily_closed. $12; 27 sites (18 trailer, 9 tent), non-electric, showers/flush/dump. --AWH lakefront agrees for site 27 (NW tip, gentle 2-3 m bank to summer pool); site 22 looks interior on the FS map. Pin ~450 m off. Phone '' -> 423-735-1500.
flags: STATUS: temporarily closed since Hurricane Helene - FS page 'Site Closed ... There is still no timeframe on repair work'; rec.gov 'CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE', April-July 2027 every night 'Closed'. Written as temporarily_closed (no status was stored).

WATERFRONT --AWH lakefront (unchanged). Agreement for site 27: on the FS map it is the last site at the NW tip with only the lakeside trail between it and the water; 3DEP at the tip 529.7 m ~30 m inland falling to the 527.0 m summer pool (~2-3 m over a gentle slope - passes the kayak test). Site 27 is first-come, not reservable on rec.gov. Possible DISAGREEMENT on site 22: the FS map puts it on the inside (north) of Loop C facing the day-use loop road, not the shore - schematic map vs firsthand, reported only. The SW-side sites (16-25) sit above a steeper bank (535.7 -> 523.3 m over ~50 m). Canopy hides every pad.

PIN MOVE ~450 m: stored 36.5635,-82.0063 (3DEP 537 m) is the peninsula's SE base near the entrance road; the three loops run NW from ~36.565,-82.0085 to the tip at ~36.568,-82.013. Suggested target Loop B centre 36.5662,-82.0100 (3DEP 544 m; stored elevation 542). OSM node 'Jacobs Creek Campground' at 36.5644,-82.0073.
PHONE '' -> 423-735-1500 (Watauga Ranger District; FS page + rec.gov facility_phone). The Helene notice also gives 423-735-1547 for questions.
No rig lengths anywhere (FS or rec.gov): 'Some sites can accommodate a travel trailer'. Inclusion unchanged.
Little Oak (named on rec.gov as the other South Holston option) is already in the file (id 27); no lead.
